data_metadata.split_rules: train/val: gentle + none only. cal/test: clean gentle share plus regime x type x severity cycle. Split by trajectory_id. test is locked.
data_metadata.sensor_model: theta and omega both measured; sensor faults corrupt theta only
data_metadata.verdict_rule: none -> trust in gentle, model_error otherwise; param_shift -> model_error; sensor_fault -> instrument_fault; unseen_force -> discovery

error_definition: L2([wrapped angle error, omega error] / train state std)
horizon_definition: First step of sustained crossing; uncrossed horizons capped at last contiguous observation
aggregation: Equal trajectory weight; capped horizon medians are lower bounds when censored
